text:
No hiring option can be put forward from this run, because the £400k annual-salary limit was not checkable in the model.

- The comparison is **fragile/very low robustness** and rests partly on machine-authored assumptions; the goal’s intended direction was also not stated, so the model treated a higher goal value as better.
- Delivery capacity is the most sensitive assumption. Its **12 productive engineer-month** starting value was accepted by you, but originated as Olumi’s estimate; changing it can change what the model implies.
- The salary constraint remains recorded but unscored, so this analysis does not establish whether any scenario meets it.
